summary: Iteration 5 (home '/'=login, registrazione tipo_soggetto, filtri spazi con 4 tipologie/formati, avvia-campagna-button, planner 4 step con moduli per comune coinvolto) fully verified end-to-end. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 14 new tests in TestRegisterTipoSoggetto (4), TestSpaziFiltriIt5 (6), TestCampagnaDatiForm (4). All 77 tests PASS in 10.2s under pytest-xdist -n 2 loadscope (63 previous regression + 14 new). Frontend Playwright covered every checklist item: (1) '/' unauth shows tab-login+tab-register — no landing; (2) tipo-privato/azienda/associazione toggle reveals correct fields (Azienda: ragione sociale + P.IVA required; Associazione: only denominazione; Privato: nothing extra); registered a new Azienda (email random) with all required fields → redirected to /dashboard; (3) authenticated visit to '/' redirects to /dashboard via homeFor(); (4) /spazi filters: filter-comune → 5 risultati Roma, +tipologia Poster Standard → 2, +formato 6x3 → 1; select shows only the 4 new tipologie (Arredo Urbano, Poster Standard, Totem Digitale, Progetto Speciale), no Billboard/Poster/Totem/Suolo pubblico legacy values; (5) avvia-campagna-button navigates to /campagne/nuova; (6) 4-step planner: step0 nome+DateRangePicker (advanced 16 months to Nov 2027, 70 free days), step1 filter Roma → 4 spazi, select first, switch filter Milano → 4 spazi, select first, planner-totale updates to '2 spazi selezionati 300.00€', next creates pratiche (2 comuni), step2 shows 2 modulo-comune-* blocks (Roma+Milano); step2 validation: click next senza compilare → planner-error 'Comune di Roma: compila Tipo richiedente, Codice fiscale, Descrizione contenuto...' PASS; compilato tipo_richiedente=Azienda (ragione_sociale+P.IVA appear dynamically), codice_fiscale, descrizione_contenuto per entrambi i comuni + next → step3 riepilogo-totale '560.00 €'; checkout-campagna-button (toast 'Pagamento simulato · MOCK-...') → invia-campagna-button → redirected to /campagne/{id} with both pratiche 'Inviata' badge + toast '2 pratiche inviate ai Comuni'. Regressione: comune.l3@demo.it login → Scrivania mostra le pratiche INVIATA della campagna (Tiburtina present). Spazio detail page shows migrated tipologia 'POSTER STANDARD' + formato '6x3' + 'Avvia candidatura' button.

issues: React console warning 'Encountered two children with the same key: test_campo' when opening step3 — caused by TestComuneBackoffice.test_form_template_get_put pushing duplicate 'test_campo' entries into Roma's form_template on every backend test run without dedupe. Not functional (just noisy console warning). Fix: either dedupe on PUT (backend) or use idempotent test payload.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py 813 lines — grew further, exceeds 700-line threshold; feature-router split (auth/spazi-pratiche/campagne/comune/admin) recommended before iteration 6.

PUT /campagne/{id}/dati-form silently returns aggiornate=0 when campagna exists but no pratiche BOZZA match; frontend doesn't surface this. Consider distinguishing 'no bozze rimaste' with a 409 or explicit flag so UI can warn user.
PUT /comune/form-template accepts duplicate campo.id — accumulates 'test_campo' duplicates from tests → React key warning. Add server-side dedupe on campo.id.

Auth.jsx submits full form (with empty tipo_soggetto/ragione_sociale/... fields) also in login mode — harmless because backend /auth/login ignores extras, but cleaner to send only {email,password} for login.

seed.py space names still start with 'Billboard' (e.g., 'Billboard Via Tiburtina') — visually confusing given tipologia migration renamed catalog to 'Poster Standard'. Consider renaming spatial nomi to match new taxonomy (or rely on tipologia label chip).

rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Minor observation: form_template on Roma comune accumulates duplicate 'test_campo' entries across pytest runs because PUT /comune/form-template does not dedupe by campo.id — causes React 'duplicate key' console warning in planner step3 (visual only, functionality intact). Fix (backend, ≤ 3 lines): in salva_template dedupe campi by id (keep last). Alternatively fix the test to use idempotent payload.
